description: Persist a task memory only when it can become a high-quality ChatCrystal note: specific title, concrete summary, meaningful key conclusions, and a durable reusable lesson such as a pitfall, fix, decision, pattern, or symptom-to-resolution mapping. Do not write one-time environment checks, version/status reports, ordinary progress logs, or vague robustness claims. Weak auto writebacks are skipped by core validation and recorded only as receipts.

memory.description: Candidate ChatCrystal note content to validate or persist as reusable task memory.

code_snippets.description: Small snippets that make the memory actionable without copying large files.

code.description: Minimal code, command, config, or query that illustrates the reusable lesson.

description.description: Why this snippet matters and when to reuse it.

language.description: Programming or markup language for the snippet.

decisions.description: Durable design, product, architecture, or process decisions made during the task.

error_signatures.description: Exact errors or symptoms that should trigger this memory in future debug recall.

files_touched.description: Files that provide useful provenance for the memory.

key_conclusions.description: Important takeaways that should be recalled before similar future work.

outcome_type.description: Primary kind of reusable memory being saved.

pitfalls.description: Mistakes, traps, or failure modes future agents should avoid.

resolution.description: Specific fix or action that resolved the issue.

reusable_patterns.description: Generalizable implementation, debugging, migration, or configuration patterns.

root_cause.description: Underlying cause of the problem when the memory is about a fix or pitfall.

summary.description: Concrete summary of what was learned or decided, written so it remains useful in a later session.

tags.description: Short tags for retrieval, such as framework, subsystem, source tool, or failure type.

title.description: Specific note title. Prefer the durable lesson over a generic task name.

mode.description: Use auto for agent-generated writebacks and manual for explicit user-curated memories.

scope.description: Store as project memory by default; global is reserved for broadly reusable manual lessons.

source_run_key.description: Idempotency key for auto writebacks; required in auto mode to avoid duplicate memory receipts.

task.description: Current task context used to scope, rank, and store memories.

branch.description: Current VCS branch when relevant to the task.

cwd.description: Current working directory of the agent session.

error_signatures.description: Concrete errors, stack traces, failing commands, or symptoms. Most useful with debug tasks.

files_touched.description: Files already touched or expected to be touched; improves project memory matching.

goal.description: Plain-language task goal or user request. Include enough context to retrieve relevant memories.

project_dir.description: Absolute project directory when known; helps ChatCrystal match memories to the right local workspace.

project_key.description: Stable project identifier used to prioritize project-scoped memories, such as a repository or workspace key.

source_agent.description: AI coding tool or agent that is calling ChatCrystal; use unknown when unsure.

task_kind.description: Kind of work being performed. Use debug for failures; choose the closest non-debug category for planned work.

name: write_task_memory
